records.question: There are twice as many cows in Devonshire as there are hearts on a standard deck of 52 playing cards. If there are 4 hearts on a card, calculate the total cost of the cows when they are sold at $200 each.
records.response:
A standard deck of 52 playing cards has 4 hearts per card.
Thus, there are 52/4 = 13 cards with hearts in a deck.
If there are twice as many cows in Devonshire as there are hearts on a card, then there are 13 * 2 = 26 cows in Devonshire.
If each cow is sold at $200, then the total cost of the cows is 26 * 200 = $5200.
#### 5200
